state.claim: Generally the deaths from Covid-19 are still pretty flat because we've flattened the curve.
state.query: What were the reported daily or weekly Covid-19 death counts over time in the relevant jurisdiction(s) around and before 2020-10-21, and do they show a flat trend?

candidates.title: Provisional COVID-19 Mortality Surveillance
candidates.snippet: Provisional death counts by time period and jurisdiction, United States. This table has counts of deaths involving COVID-19 and other select causes of death by time-period in which the death occurred.

candidates.title: COVID-19 data | WHO COVID-19 dashboard
candidates.snippet: WHO stopped requiring daily basis data reporting since August 2023 and the data presented in this dashboard are weekly frequency.

candidates.title: Coronavirus (COVID-19) Deaths - Our World in Data
candidates.snippet: This page provides data on the number of confirmed deaths from COVID-19. Research has shown that these figures are an underestimate of the total pandemic death toll. This is because of limited testing, poorly functioning death registries, challenges in determining the cause of death, and disruptions during the pandemic.
